info.title: AuthWAPI
info.description: Self-hosted auth server (M1). Every path below is under BASE_URL/api/auth except the ones that declare their own server. Every request must use a Host that is BASE_URL's host or in ALLOWED_HOSTS (421 `unknown_host` otherwise). An Origin header, if sent, must be BASE_URL's origin or an ALLOWED_HOSTS name (403 `untrusted_origin` otherwise), and a POST to a Better Auth route that sends any cookie must send it (403 `MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN` otherwise). Errors from core routes are `{ "code", "message" }`; OAuth endpoints answer `{ "error", "error_description" }`. Routes under /api/auth are rate-limited per client IP (429 with `X-Retry-After`; the Pages routes answer an HTML error page instead). Request and response schemas are generated from Better Auth.

Sign up a user using email and password

post.description:
Sign in with magic link

Signs in an existing account only, never creates one. The link works once, for 5 minutes. No email is sent for an address with no account, and one address gets at most one link a minute, but the answer is the same. `callbackURL`, `newUserCallbackURL` and `errorCallbackURL` must be on BASE_URL or an ALLOWED_HOSTS name.

email.description: Email address to send the magic link

name.description: User display name. Only used if the user is registering for the first time. Eg: "my-name"

callbackURL.description: URL to redirect after magic link verification

newUserCallbackURL.description: URL to redirect after new user signup. Only used if the user is registering for the first time.

metadata.description: Additional metadata to pass to sendMagicLink.

get.description:
Authorize an OAuth 2.1 request from query parameters or an application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST body

Open this in the browser. Authorization code flow only; PKCE with `S256` is required. Scopes: `openid`, `email`, `offline_access`. Pass `resource=<api>` to get a JWT access token for that API (the client must be registered for it).

get.summary: Verify an email address (the link in the verification email)
get.description: Shows a form that asks for the password chosen at sign-up. Verifies nothing.

post.summary: Verify an email address (the link in the verification email)
post.description: Marks the email verified only if the password matches the one the account was created with, so someone who signed up with your address cannot get in when you verify it. Limited to 20 tries per IP and 5 per account every 5 minutes.

400.description: Missing password, or the link is broken or expired

401.description: Wrong password

409.description: The password changed while verifying, or the account has no password

429.description: Too many tries

500.description: The password could not be checked; nothing changed

get.summary: Sign in with a magic link (the link in the email)
get.description: Shows "Sign in as you@example.com?" with a Continue button. Consumes nothing, so mail scanners cannot use the link up.

400.description: The link is invalid, used or expired

post.summary: Sign in with a magic link (the link in the email)
post.description: Signs in and sets the session cookie. Limited to 5 a minute per IP.

303.description: Signed in: redirects to the callbackURL. A bad, used or expired link: redirects to the errorCallbackURL (else the callbackURL, else `/`) with `?error=INVALID_TOKEN` and sets no cookie.

400.description: Too many tries, or another error
